distant_fog._comment: CLOUDREACH-LOOK-0906 owner addendum: 'floating islands read as flat grey unrendered slabs (fog flattens them)'. The render fog Environment lives in scenes/world/cloudreach_cliffs.tscn and is re-applied every frame by world_look.gd from data/config/art.json's time-of-day presets plus cloudreach_visual.json's own fog_density_add delta (that file is owned by a concurrent pass in this same visual sweep, so it is not touched here). This block is read directly by scripts/world/cloudreach_look.gd instead: fog_depth_begin/fog_depth_curve are properties WorldLook never writes, so setting them once keeps 0-fog_depth_begin_m completely clear; fog_density_scale/aerial_perspective_scale are reapplied every frame AFTER WorldLook's own write, the same 'reapply on top of the owner' pattern WorldLook itself uses for weather. Target: a region/landmark 400-900 m out keeps at least 35% of its local contrast instead of washing to flat grey.
